info.title: JobCopilot API v1
info.description: Version 1 of the JobCopilot Autonomous Career Operating System REST API.

post.description: Registers a new multi-tenant candidate account with Argon2id password hashing.
Authenticates user credentials, enforces brute-force lockout, MFA gate, and issues JWT tokens.
Rotates refresh token, revokes old token, and issues a new access token.
Revokes the current access token in the database blacklist and deactivates active session.

get.description: Returns the authenticated candidate's identity and subscription tier.

post.description: Initiates TOTP enrollment, generates secret, QR provisioning URI, and backup recovery codes.
Verifies TOTP code against pending secret and finalizes MFA activation.
Verifies MFA challenge token with TOTP code or backup recovery code, issuing full JWT.
Disables MFA after verifying the user's password or current TOTP code.

get.description: Lists all active device sessions for the authenticated candidate.

delete.description: Revokes all active sessions for the user except the current one.
Revokes a specific device session and blacklists its token.

get.description: Returns security audit log events pertaining to the authenticated user.
Public healthcheck endpoint.

Unauthenticated config the login gate needs to render the correct sign-in UI.

Exposes only the public OAuth client id (safe to ship to browsers) and whether
the demo/email-only path should be offered — never any secret.

post.description:
Authenticates with a Google ID token, then applies the same MFA gate as password login.

Audit P0-4 hardening:
  * the audience (client id) check can never be skipped,
  * Google must assert email_verified,
  * the email comes only from the verified token, never the request body,
  * the tokenless demo path is gated on settings (not os.environ) and is off in production,
  * deactivated accounts are refused, and MFA is enforced via complete_login().
Uploads and parses a resume (PDF, DOCX, or text) and auto-prefills questionnaire.

get.description: Retrieves current candidate profile for authenticated tenant.

put.description: Saves the user's corrections to skills, work history and education.

get.description: Retrieves the recruiter questions schema and prefilled answers.

post.description: Applies user-confirmed answers to profile and Knowledge Vault.

get.description: Returns all indexed Q&A slots for the authenticated tenant.

post.description: Manually teaches or updates a Q&A slot.

Triggers an async 0-day job discovery cycle across ATS APIs and VC boards.

Rate-limited (per user/IP): discovery fans out to many external ATS/VC feeds,
so this caps abuse and runaway cost. Deeper per-tier daily quotas live in the
RateLimiter singleton.

get.description: Returns current discovery metrics with caching.

A company's logo for the job lists. Open (image tags can't send a sign-in token) and
rate-limited; "no logo" is an empty 204 so the app falls back to the initial quietly.

A short description of a company in its own words, and its website. Either may be null.

With `job_id` (one of the user's jobs at this company), the posting's own "About us"
part fills in when the company's website has no summary.

Returns all tracked job applications for the authenticated tenant.

The list leaves each job's description out (it is most of the weight and no list shows
it); GET /jobs/{job_id} returns one job in full. `descriptions=true` keeps them in.

patch.description: Updates the pipeline status of a tracked job application.
Saves the user's own notes on a job or application ("spoke to Priya, follow up Friday").

post.description: Hides a match and, when the reason says something reusable, skips similar jobs in new searches.

get.description: What new searches skip because of the user's "Not interested" reasons.

delete.description: Stops skipping jobs for one rule. Jobs it skipped can come back in the next search.

patch.description: Sets (or clears) the interview date for a tracked application.

post.description:
Compiles a tailored PDF resume, cover letter, and outreach package for a job.

Rate-limited (per user/IP): each call runs LLM resume tailoring + cover-letter
+ outreach generation, so this caps runaway AI cost from a single account.

put.description: Picks the AI wording or the user's own for this job's resume. Applying uses this pick.

post.description: Manually records an offline recruiter call or phone screen.

get.description: One job in full, description included.

post.description: Generates 280-char LinkedIn connection note and email for alumni referral outreach.
Generates polite, high-converting recruiter follow-up message.

get.description: Returns all pending HITL questions for authenticated tenant.

post.description: Atomically resolves a pending HITL question strictly for the authenticated tenant.
Atomically resolves held application, saves Q&A to vault, and resumes submission.
Executes full autonomous stealth application workflow with persistent rate limiting and idempotency.

Dispatches asynchronous application task to Celery/Redis background worker queue with idempotency checks.
Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a unique task_id for progress polling.

Dispatches asynchronous application task to Celery/Redis background worker queue with idempotency checks.
Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a unique task_id for progress polling.

get.description: Polls progress and completion status for an asynchronous background task.
Returns paginated application audit ledger history for authenticated tenant.

The automatic-apply record for a job, or ledger: null if JobCopilot never applied to it
(e.g. an application the user made and tracked themselves). That's a normal state, not an error.
Returns visual evidence (screenshot path, DOM snapshot, field selector) for a HITL challenge.

post.description:
Public webhook receiver for external email providers (Postmark, SendGrid, Mailgun).
Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature and attributes incoming email to tenant via subaddress.
Processes incoming recruiter email and syncs pipeline for authenticated tenant.

get.description: Returns all parsed recruiter communications for authenticated tenant.

post.description: Generates and saves a follow-up draft for a submitted application.

get.description: Generates technical architecture dossier and interview rounds for target company.
Generates role-specific mock technical, system design, and STAR leadership questions.

post.description: Evaluates candidate response with multi-dimensional STAR scoring.
Triggers an interview invitation alert and provides role-customized mock interview questions.

get.description: Generates strategic questions to ask the hiring manager.

post.description: Infers interviewer persona, technical biases, and strategic preparation advice.

get.description: Fetches company public engineering blog initiatives.
Calculates non-conflicting interview scheduling windows.

post.description: Benchmarks job offer against market percentiles.
Models startup ESOP ownership and future exit returns.
Compares multiple offers with 4-year TC progression and liquidation analysis.
Generates tailored executive negotiation email and phone talking points.
Generates an Anti-AI counter-offer negotiation email.

get.description: The user's plan (Free or Premium), subscription state, and Premium prices.

post.description: Creates a Premium subscription; the page then opens Razorpay Checkout with its id.
Confirms the Checkout payment and turns Premium on (the webhook does the same).
Stops renewal; Premium stays on until the end of the paid month.
Razorpay subscription events (signed with the webhook secret).

get.description: Securely streams object storage files with tenant verification, expiry checks, and path traversal defense.
Lists all registered users with optional search filter.
Returns platform-wide metrics: user count, job count, application count, tier breakdown.

post.description:
Issues an audit-logged, short-lived JWT access token allowing an admin to impersonate a tenant.
All actions performed under this token contain an explicit 'impersonated_by' audit claim.

get.description: Retrieves paginated admin audit trail.
Retrieves system-wide security audit logs and anomaly alerts (Admin only).

patch.description: Updates a user's subscription or system role.

post.description:
GDPR Article 20 (Right to Data Portability).
Generates and returns an exhaustive, machine-readable JSON archive of all
candidate data across all tables, decrypting stored PII.

delete.description:
GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure / Hard Delete).
Permanently erases all database records tied to the candidate, cancels active
Stripe and Razorpay subscriptions, purges file uploads, and revokes credentials.
Requires the account email plus re-authentication (password, or TOTP when MFA is on).

get.description: Retrieves the candidate's active consent states across all tracked consent categories.

post.description:
Records an append-only, audited consent grant or revocation decision.
Tracks client IP address and user-agent string for regulatory compliance.

get.description: Returns the complete immutable chronological audit trail of consent grants and revocations.
